content: Mboti
Yilutumini Foyiba, phangi wetu wa mukhetu, yandi wenina musadi ku Dibundu dya Nzambi ku Sakhe

ndangu lwalenga muyamba mu zina dya Pfumu muna mutindu wa luzitu kwena bakwikidi. Musadisenu muna kosu kima kina kakala kyawu mupfunu kwena benu, mukuma ndesi wa batu balawu kákala, ata kwena meni-meni.
Bahekenu mboti Phisikila yi Akilasi, bakwetu bama ba kisalu mwena Kidisitu Yesu
Babana bakhana fwa kikuma kya kuhulula moya wa meni; ka meni hika ku yisi baheka matondu kaasi hakimosi phi yi Mabundu mosu ma batu bana beku Bayuta.
Hanenu phi mboti ku Dibundu dina dyenina muna nzu ya bawu. Muhekenu mboti Ephayineti, watondama wama, yandi kena bibundu bya theti mu kukwikila mwena Kidisitu mu kinzunga kya Aziya.
Muhekenu mboti Madiya, wádiyangisa lawu kikuma kya benu.
Bahekenu mboti Andonikusi yi Yunyasi, benina biwutu byama amana phi mwa twakadila bawu mu boloku. Bisi bazola lawu mukati dya bathumwa, bawu bátekila kituka bakidisitu ku thwala ya meni.
Muhekenu mboti Aphidyatusi watondama wama mwena Pfumu.
Bahekenu mboti Yidibe mukwetu wama wa kisalu mwena Kidisitu, yi Sitaki, watondama wama.
Muhekenu mboti Aphelesi, wásongila mihangu myandi mya lukwikilu mwena Kidisitu. Bahekenu mboti baba benina mu nzu ya Adisitobudi.
Muhekenu mboti Helodyoni, wenina kiwutu kyama. Bahekenu mboti babana benina mu nzu ya Nadisisi benina mu kisalu kya Pfumu.
Bahekenu mboti Thifeni yi Thifosi, bakhetu bana bádihana mu kisalu kya Pfumu. Muhekenu mboti Phedisidi, watondama wama, yandi wányokuka lawu mu kisalu kya Pfumu.
Muhekenu mboti Difusi
, yandi wuna wásolama mu kisalu kya Pfumu, yi ngudi wandi, wenina phi ngudi wa meni.
Bahekenu mboti Asikiti, Felekoni, Hedimesi, Phatobasi, Hedimasi yi baphangi babana benina bawu.
Bahekenu mboti Filoloki yi Zudi, Neleya yi phangi wandi wa mukhetu, hakimosi yi Odiphasi yi bakwikidi babana benina bawu.
Dihekakenu mboti benu yi benu mu kuyambana kwatoma. Mabundu moosu ma Kidisitu mboti maluhekini.
Kukebisa kwa tsuka
Yilulombini, baphangi bama, lwalenga keba kikuma kya batu babana bisi nata kayengu yi kubwisisa batu, konda kulandaka malongi mana lwábonga. Kadilenu bawu kyana.
Mukuma batu ba buna bisiku sadila Kidisitu, Pfumu wetu, kaasi kundu dya bawu meni
. Mu lengu ndinga yi mu mazasa, bisi huna mbundu za batu bakonda dyambu.
Kikuma kya benu, bulemvu bwenu buzayakani kwena batu boosu; amana yisi sangwala kikuma kya benu, kaasi nzodi ni lwadimuka mu mambu mamboti bwosu lwenina ba kasemi mu mambu mambi.
Amana Nzambi wa ngemba ka thama ku kamutusuna Satana muna malu menu. Khenda za Pfumu wetu Yesu zakala yi benu
Mukwetu wama wa kisalu, Thimoti
, mboti kaluhekini, hakimosi yi Disyusi, Yasoni yi Sosiphatele, benina biwutu byama.
Mboti yiluhekini, meni Tedityusi, yandu wusonikini mukanda wawu, muna zina dya Pfumu.
Ngayusi, yandu wángyamba yi Dibundu dyosu, mboti baluhekini. Elasiti, wuna wisi sweka bima bya ha mbanza, mboti kaluhekini, hakimosi yi phangi Kaditusi
Khenda za Pfumu wetu Yesu Kidisitu zakala yi benu boosu. Abwabuna
Nzitusu ya tsuka
Kwena yandu wenina yi kiyeka kya kulusyamisa mu lukwikilu bwosu bwenina Musamu wama wa Bukheti yi kusamuna Yesu Kidisitu -bwosu bwenina nzayikisa ya kitsweki kina kyáswama tukila mvula yi mvula,
kaasi wisi disongila buthwena mu Masonuku ma bambikudi, muna mutindu wuna kábasongila Nzambi wa mvula yi mvula, wuna bánata mu nzayilu ya makanda ndangu balemvuka mu lukwikilu -
kwena Nzambi, yandi mosi wa nduka, khembu mu Yesu Kidisitu, bilumbu byosu! Abwabuna!

footnotes.text: Mazina ma bakidisitu mana kabati zonzila thumwa, matuki mu bisina bya mutindu yi mutindu (Bangeleki, Baloma yi Bayuta) kondilo mu mana matadidini luzingu lwa bawu mu kimvuka (batu bana bátumbuka ndinga, bahika holo bahika bana ba thama). Kikuma kya Phisikila yi Akilasi: tala Mhb 18:2.; 18:26; 1Ko 16:19; 2Th 4:19
Mihowu myami: Khenda za Pfumu wetu Yesu zakala yi benu myeninamwoku muna masonuku mahika.
Muna masonuku mahika ma khulu, yeninamwoku nzila yayi.
